description: Get the full text of a federal court rule, optionally one subdivision. Covers the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP, e.g. "Rule 64 seizing a person or property", "Rule 12(b)(6)", "Rule 56"), Evidence (FRE, e.g. "803(6) business records hearsay exception"), Appellate Procedure (FRAP, e.g. "Rule 4 time to appeal"), Criminal Procedure (FRCrP) and Bankruptcy Procedure (FRBP). Pass the citation pieces: set="frcp", rule="64", subdivision="(b)" -- or rule="64(b)" / "4(a)(1)(B)". Returns the requested subdivision text (when given), the whole rule text, the amendment/effective credit line, whether Advisory Committee notes exist (include_notes=true returns them), and a source link. An unknown rule number or subdivision returns an explicit not-found.

include_notes.description: Include Advisory Committee notes / committee notes text (truncated at 12,000 characters). Default false.

rule.description: Rule number, optionally with subdivisions: "64", "4.1", "803(6)", "12(b)(6)". A leading "Rule" is ignored.

set.description: Rule set: frcp (Civil Procedure), fre (Evidence), frap (Appellate), frcrp (Criminal Procedure), frbp (Bankruptcy). Aliases such as frcrmp and "civil" are accepted.

subdivision.description: Optional subdivision path, e.g. "(b)" or "(a)(1)(B)". Appended to any subdivision already in rule.

name: get_federal_rule
title: Get Federal Rule
